text:
mel_partnerships: Short sync - PM wants a single marketplace publish but vendors report mixed readiness (MI300 delayed, Gaudi has NIC scaling bug). Thoughts on splitting waves vs single announce with partner-preview?
anna_amd: MI300 pilot boards hit customs delay, realistic ETA ~July 2 now. Can try to fast-track one validation batch but not guaranteed.
oliver_nvidia: H100/H200/B200 are green from our side. We can provide H200 test image and firmware tags by Tue.
yasmin_si: SI impact: image set + cert matrix need to be final 72h pre-publish. If MI300/Gaudi land late we must either: 1) omit them from public wave, 2) include them as "partner preview" with limited regions.
hector_ops: Ops requirement: SKU IDs and image URIs 72h before go-time. Region rollout plan: canary us-west -> eu-central -> rest. If we split waves, we need separate release notes and SKU suffixes.
lucy_marketing: Marketing prefers a single coherent story. Suggest announce core SKUs public + a "coming soon (partner preview)" section for others, with a follow-up patch note when they land.
sam_legal: Language check: use "partner preview" or "compatibility preview". Avoid hard ship dates publicly. Partner-only access needs signed asset approval 48h before PR.
release-bot: Event created: "Marketplace core announce (H100/H200/B200)"  2026-06-22  https://calendar.redwood.ai/e/mkt-core-2026-06-22
mel_partnerships: Decision: proceed with core wave (H100/H200/B200) on 2026-06-22; list MI300 and Gaudi as "partner preview / coming soon". Contingency: if vendors confirm by 2026-06-18 we can hot-add SKUs up to 48h pre-announce. Owners - comms: mel_partnerships, SI cert: yasmin_si, ops: hector_ops, vendors: anna_amd/oliver_nvidia, legal: sam_legal.
yasmin_si: I'll draft the cert matrix and a "compat-preview" SI lane with relaxed perf gates. PR by EOD.
anna_amd: I'll post any changes to MI300 ETA here immediately.
oliver_nvidia: We'll share H200 image URI by Tue.
mel_partnerships: Thanks all. We'll keep this thread for updates only. Closing unless timelines change. :white_check_mark:
